report.title: Sign-up, checkout and accessibility check: Brindlebeck Tool Co. (fictional demo shop)
report.method: Automated checks (axe-core) plus a scripted journey run

in: My account: login and sign-up forms (signed out)
out: Manual keyboard pass (not done in this run)
scope.data_note: Fictional shop and sample data only.

findings.title: Header menu list contains a nested list directly

also_on: My account: login and sign-up forms (signed out)

affects.how: The header menu list holds another list directly, so the menu structure and item count can be announced wrongly.

confidence.basis: axe-core rule violation on a named element, same result on 8 page(s)

findings.recommendation: Wrap the nested list in an li element, or render the page list as list items of the parent list.

evidence.quote: Fix all of the following:   List element has direct children that are not allowed: ul

findings.title: ARIA reference may point at a missing element

element.snippet: <a href="#" role="button" class="woocommerce-product-gallery__trigger" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-controls="photoswipe-fullscreen-dialog" aria-label="View full-screen image gallery">

affects.how: An ARIA reference points at an element that may not exist, so related help or a linked dialog may not be announced.

confidence.basis: axe-core could not decide (needs review); no manual check yet

findings.recommendation: Make sure the referenced id exists in the page whenever the attribute is present.

evidence.quote: Fix all of the following:   Unable to determine if aria-controls referenced ID exists on the page while using aria-haspopup: aria-controls="photoswipe-fullscreen-dialog"

findings.title: Quantity buttons: visible symbol may not match the button name

element.snippet: <button aria-label="Reduce quantity of Screwdriver Set (4 piece)" class="wc-block-components-quantity-selector__button wc-block-components-quantity-selector__button--minus" disabled="">\u2212</button>

affects.how: They say what they see. If the visible symbol is not part of the button name, the voice command may not match.

confidence.basis: axe-core could not decide (needs review); no manual check yet

findings.recommendation: Check with a speech input tool. If needed, make the accessible name start with the visible text.

evidence.quote: Fix any of the following:   Unable to determine if the visible text is part of the accessible name

findings.title: Privacy policy link returns 404

affects.how: They cannot read the privacy policy before signing up or paying.

confidence.basis: HTTP status recorded by the test run

findings.expected: The link opens the privacy policy.
findings.recommendation: Publish the privacy policy page, or point the link at the right page.

findings.title: Checkout terms sentence has no links

element.description: Terms sentence above the place order button

affects.how: They are asked to agree to terms they cannot open from the checkout.

confidence.basis: Link count recorded by the test run

findings.actual: Text: "By proceeding with your purchase you agree to our Terms and Conditions and Privacy Policy". Links in it: 0.
findings.recommendation: Link "Terms and Conditions" and "Privacy Policy" to their pages.

evidence.quote: By proceeding with your purchase you agree to our Terms and Conditions and Privacy Policy

findings.title: All 12 journey steps passed (sign-up, login, search, cart, checkout, order)

affects.how: The core buying journey works end to end.

confidence.basis: Each step has a pass check and a screenshot
